catalog_quirks.body: CLōD grants 100 requests per day across eligible free models, automatically replenished, with no card required. This is daily, not monthly, and not a separate grant per model. Use the exact friendly model IDs including spaces. Only four routes returned consistent upstream identities in live tests; Llama and Trinity aliases that substituted Gemma are excluded. Matching response IDs do not independently verify the served weights. Context and tool support are not claimed without provider-specific evidence.
